subject: Re: Demo request - Acme multi-stakeholder scheduling
messages:
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-18T16:24:00-07:00
Subject: Interested in Redwood - Demo request

Hi Marissa,

I signed up on the site and would love to get a quick demo next week. We're evaluating inference platforms for a customer-facing feature and I want to include our SE and security lead.

Attendees likely: myself (Product), Priya Singh (Engineering), and our Security team (security@acme.com). We're in ET (New York) but Priya is currently in CET (Berlin) until Friday.

Top asks: throughput/latency at 2k qps, integration options for private deployment, and security/compliance (SOC 2 + audit logs).

What points do you have available for next week? We're flexible on Wed/Thu afternoons ET if that helps.

Thanks,
Sam
Product Manager, Acme Corp

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, ava.chen@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-18T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood - Demo request

Hi Sam — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for signing up and sharing the attendee list.

I’ve looped in Ben (our SDR) to coordinate a time and Ava (our SE) for the technical deep dive. Also adding internal security for visibility to ensure we surface the right artifacts.

Ben — can you propose 2-3 times next week that cover ET afternoons and are also workable for someone on CET? Prefer to include a 30–45 minute slot for demo + 15 for security/Q&A.

Sam — quick ask: are there any hard blackout dates for Priya this week (Wed/Thu afternoon ET is ok on your side)?

I’ll attach a short agenda and our standard IT checklist once we confirm a slot.

Best,
Marissa Cole

marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood - Demo request

Thanks Marissa — looping in Logan from our security team as well for any compliance questions.

Sam — proposed times (all shown in ET / CET equivalent):
- Wed 2026-06-23 2:00pm ET / 8:00pm CET (30–45m)
- Wed 2026-06-23 4:30pm ET / 10:30pm CET (45m) — later option if Priya prefers end-of-day CET
- Thu 2026-06-24 1:00pm ET / 7:00pm CET (30–45m)

The Wed 4:30pm ET / 10:30pm CEST is too late for us. Thu 1:00pm ET / 7:00pm CEST works for me, but I’d prefer we make the session 45 minutes so we have time for the security Q&A.

Also, can you share any pre-read on integration options (VPC/private deployment) and an agenda? Our security team will want to review the checklist ahead of the meeting.

Cheers,
